13825.html:
13825 sphāṭayati '*causes to split' ('hurts, injures' Dhātup.). 2. Pass. *sphāṭyatē. [√sphaṭ]
    1. Pk. phāḍēi 'splits', NiDoc. phaḍitaǵa (?); Gy. eur. phar-, SEeur. phai̦- tr. 'to burst, split' (wel. boh. pharav- tr., gr. parav- tr., paravdí 'vulva'); K.pog. phārnu 'to beat'; S. phāṛaṇu 'to tear, split'; P. phāṛṇā 'to split', WPah. (Joshi) fāṛnu 'to tear, split, break'; Ku. phāṛṇo 'to split', N. phārnu, B. phāṛā, Or. phāṛibā, Mth. phārab, OAw. phāraï, lakh. phārab, H. phāṛnā, OMarw. phāḍaï, G. phāṛvũ, M. phāḍṇẽ 'to split'; Si. paḷanavā 'to cleave, tear asunder'; — MIA. *phāḍīadi: Gy. germ. phary-, pharyĕv- intr. 'to burst'; Sh. (Lor.) phaïǰoiki intr. 'to tear, be torn'; Si. pälenavā 'to be split'.
    2. Pk. phaṭṭaï 'is split'; K. phāṭh, dat. °ṭas m. 'splitting' (with expressive or 'intrusive' r: phrāṭun tr. 'to split'); S. phāṭaṇu intr. 'to burst, tear'; L. phāṭaṇ 'to beat'; P. phāṭṇā 'to be split'; WPah. (Joshi) fāṭṇu tr.(?) 'to break'; Ku. phaṭṇo 'to be split', N. phāṭnu, A. phāṭiba, B. phāṭā, Or. phāṭibā, Bi. Mth. phāṭab, H. phāṭnā (whence, with characteristic short vowel of intr., phaṭnā → P. phaṭṇā), OMarw. phāṭaï, G. phāṭvũ, M. phāṭṇẽ.
    Addenda: sphāṭayati. 1. S.kcch. phāṛṇū 'to tear'; — with intrusive r WPah.kṭg. phráṛnõ 'to pierce or burst open'; A. phāliba 'to split' rather than < sphālayati (but -l- < -ṭ- ?) AFD 333.
    2. *sphāṭyatē: S.kcch. phāṭṇū intr. 'to burst', WPah.kṭg. pháṭṇõ 'to be crushed'; Md. faḷanī 'chops, rips, unties (sail)', pass. feḷenī 'is torn' (feḷum 'operation, unfurling of sail').

14021.html:
14021 hásati 'laughs' ṢaḍvBr. [√has]
    Pa. hasati 'laughs', Pk. hasaï, Dm. as-, ãs-, Tir. az-, Paš.nir. dar. az-, kuṛ. āz-, Kho. hosik, Bshk. has-, Phal. 1 sg. hāsum, Sh.gil. hăyóĭki̯ (1 sg. hām), koh. gur. hăžōnṷ, K. asun, Ku. hãsṇo; N. (ext. -kk-) haskanu 'to smile'; Or. hasibā, hãs° 'to laugh', Mth. hasab, hãs°, Bhoj. hãsal, Aw.lakh. hãsab, H. hasnā, Marw. hasṇo, hãs°, G. hasvũ, M. hasṇẽ, hãs°. — Paš.ar. ezi-, Shum. äiz-: rather < *abhihasati Add. or hāsayati?
    Addenda: hásati: Kho. also osik 'to laugh' BKhoT 71; Garh. hãsṇu 'to laugh'.

14048.html:
14048 *hasyatē impers. 'one laughs'. [√has]
    Pa. hassati 'laughs' (collides with hassati 'is glad' < hŕ̥ṣyati), Pk. hassaï, Gy. eur. 3 sg. asel, pal. ḫázăr (-z- ?), Ḍ. hΛsiná, Tor. has-, L. hassaṇ, (Ju.) hasaṇ, awāṇ. hassuṇ, P. hassṇā, ludh. hasnā, WPah.bhal. hasṇū, bhad. hasnū (pp. hassu), khaś. hεssyεũ pret. impers. 'it was laughed', rudh. hassuā, N. hā̃snu, A. hā̃hiba, B. hāsā, hā̃sā, H. hā̃snā, M. hā̃sṇẽ, Ko. hāstā.
    Addenda: *hasyatē: WPah.kṭg. hásṇõ, kc. hɔsṇo, hasiṇo 'to laugh', caus. kṭg. (kc.) həsáuṇõ, Wkc. həsεuṇo.
    HĀ²: †*ujjihītē, †*ujjhāpayati.

10452.html:
10452 yā́ti 'goes, approaches, comes to' RV. [√yā]
    Pa. yāti 'goes, goes on', Aś.sn. yāti, man. kāl. yaṁti 3 pl., Pk. jāi, jāï, Gy. eur. ǰal 3 sg., pal. ǰar, arm. ǰa-; Paš.nir. žā- 'to come', Niṅg. z- NOGaw 61, Shum. zē-, Gaw. ži-, ǰi- (2 sg. imper. ǰɔ̈̄), Bshk. y- (yantə 'am coming'), Tor. y- (2 sg. imper. yai < yāhí), Phal. y-, yh- (2 sg. imper. yah, pres. yhāndu 'am coming'), K. yunᵘ (or < aíti?), ḍoḍ. jaiṇō; L. jāh 2 sg. imper. of vañjaṇ 'to go', P. jāṇā (2 sg. imper. jāh), WPah.cam. jāṇā, Ku. jāṇo, N. jānu, A. zāiba, B. jāoyā, Or. jibā (1 sg. pres. jāũ), Bi. Mth. jāeb, Aw.lakh. jāib, H. jānā, OMarw. jāvaï (2 sg. imper. jā), OG. jāi, G. jā̆vũ, M. j̈āṇẽ, Si. yanavā (OSi. 3 pl. pres. yat). — Fut. yāsyati > *yāssa- > *yāsa- poss. in Sh.gil. yayóĭki̯ (1 sg. pres. yāya̯m) 'walk, go, come', koh. yazōnṷ, gur. yāžōnṷ.
    Addenda: yā́ti: WPah.kṭg. (kc.) jāṇõ (pret. gɔ < gatá-) 'to go', with inf. 'must, may'; Garh. jāṇu 'to go'; Md. danī 'goes' (absol. gos < gácchati), inf. dān, pres. 3 sg. dē, diyum, diyaum 'going'.

5055.html:
5055 chupáti 'touches' Dhātup. [√chup]
    Pa. chupati, Pk. chuvaï, N. chunu, A. soiba, B. chũyā, Or. chũibā, chõi°, Mth. chūyab, OAw. chuvaï, lakh. chūab, H. chūnā, G. chuvũ. — X *kṣubhati: S. chuhaṇu, P. chuhuṇā, chohṇā, WPah. cam. chūhṇā, bhiḍ. 1 sg. pret. chüiyũ < chupita-, OH. chuhnā. — X kṣipáti: Pk. chivaï 'touches'; Gy. eur. čiv- 'to throw, put', SEeur. čhiv- 'to throw'; Tir. 2 pl. imper. tsiya 'put'; Sh. (Lor.) čivoiki, st. čivī- 'to put down'; OMarw. chīvā- 'to cause to touch'; M. śivṇẽ 'to touch'. — *kṣubhati and kṣipáti: Pk. chihaï 'touches'. — X kṣúbhyati: Sh. čhŭbóĭki̯ 'to place'.
    Addenda: chupáti: WPah.kṭg. (kc.) ċhv̄̃ṇõ (with high level tone) 'to touch', J. chū̃wṇu; kṭg. ċhwáuṇõ 'to cause to be touched'.
    CHR̥D: †*aticchardati, †*avacchardati.
    *chr̥ndati see chárdati Add².
    †*chēṭ- 'sprinkle' see *chiṭ-.
    *chēḍ-² 'make angry' see *ciḍ- Add².
